CHAPTER.VERS: Let them praise the name of Yahweh; For he commanded, and they were created.
He has also established them forever and ever: He has made a decree which will not pass away.
Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;
Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;
Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:
Let them praise the name of Yahweh; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
And he has lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the sons of Israel, a people near to him. Hallelujah.
